E0113

`return` value mismatch (wrong/missing/unexpected)

What

`return` value mismatch (wrong/missing/unexpected)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0113

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0113: tests/ui/ffi_undo_non_unit_return.stderr.

Error [E0113]: undo function `undo_mutate` returns `Int`, but rollback functions must return Unit
  --> tests/ui/ffi_undo_non_unit_return.jet:2:11
    |
  2 |     #Undo(undo_mutate) fn mutate(left: Int, right: Int) Int = "std::cmp::max"
    |           ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: rollback invokes the inverse for its side effect and cannot use a returned value
 Fix: remove `Int` from `undo_mutate` so it returns Unit
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0113
